'''Qotile''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]]<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|III|57|Qotile}}</ref> located within the [[Qotile system/Legends|Qotile system]], in the [[Colundra sector/Legends|Colundra sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Ravaged by the [[Stark Hyperspace War/Legends|Stark Hyperspace Conflict]], a deserter fled here and established himself [[King/Legends|king]], though it would not be long before the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]] claimed the bounty and inherited the title.<ref name="TCSWE" />
